![jeremy-bishop-vGjGvtSfys4-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielkuye/23uR7LefN6QZF2LToHZLqjmnAwSEb2gUgpjtTSH215dmnp9D7tEuuNwE4EbQxhuZpmDXS.jpg)


Hello everyone"

Welcome to Hive Blockchain a place of opportunities and self development to everyone who's a Hivian,a place where you can grow your world and make a change around you both financially and interlectualy,all you need is just to put your mind to work,I can assure you that it's not an easy flow thing,we know that every success has to be builded from the scratch,so if you want to give life a fight and win then get to work.


![nik-z1d-LP8sjuI-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielkuye/23yd3i2hETztRtfhXbpv3nkYa7xK9GbWVxG9WwwAK9bfYEkCEFL3kQ4hMAVH5Kmwrbg3h.jpg)


* As we all know, the platform is like your empty room,fill it up with your vital items,so that who ever comes in will like to stay,I have come to realize that Hive is a very large world, it's a one platform for many people who are willing to build success,put in much effort just to get a  colorful results,I have heard people share their testimonies about HIVE and it's not a thing to joke about I think,let this platform inspire you to challenge yourself for growth, I have some key things to share that will help grow you faster and better.


![olena-bohovyk-DmeZC9riGkk-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielkuye/23uQpMmmst2vVHeLySafiBHbhvHnDMmhPMkPwGAHjmBFcw3tpUG9d6oV3WHXNQag1Xriw.jpg)


* CREATE THE BEST YOU CAN.
As a Hivian you should double up your pursuit for excellence, observe what you post on a daily bases and have a way of detecting wether you are growing or not in every post you make,the drive to creating good contents should never drop low even if the demand is high and you have limited time to meet up, stick to your brand,what ever content you create in Hive exposes to people the power of your mind.


![gabriel-gurrola-2UuhMZEChdc-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielkuye/23vrtNmtp8Z87exxj6ecqbz846f42VoWbt8Sfgbdnyf2DoL2QX91BVa857vkjfLwuPUhf.jpg)


* THE HIVIAN'S ACTIVITY.
We all are known for a specific gift or talents,but when it comes to exploring into the public you have to employ diversity in your gift as different people are expecting different thing from one source and that's you,for instance; if you are a writer,your writing should affect different areas of life and even cultures that are not yours,that means you have to put yourself to studies and research,and if  you are a singer,you should be able to sing more than one genre of music even though you still maintain your uniqueness as maybe an afro singer, classic ,blues,rap or even learn one musical instrument at least,just be creative and try new things that will keep your followers engaged, good content always.


![istockphoto-2073120208-1024x1024.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielkuye/23tbMPZem6gFBuLp67TnvQKwMyC6Gdg5itMzn875mx3o7NjsD2aKH41QHghciCoz3JhAe.jpg)


* BUILDING RELATIONSHIP.
Connect to different people across the universe as much as you can,one thing that has always helped me is that " where ever I go to I tend to build a bond of families where I can feel at home always"... hive is a large world don't just make post and log-out or just comment back on people who commented on your post,reach-out to people so you can build friendship.



* THE MONEY MINDSET.
We are so excited to know that we can make earnings just by posting our content and getting some reactions,one thing I know is people who place all their focus on just making money no matter how will end up Lossing all they have gathered one day,good contents should come first, chasing money is not the best mindset if you want to gain financial freedom , build a channel and money will follow through that channel on a steady,even the Bible says " seek ye first the kingdom of God and his righteousness and all other things shall be added unto you"...I think that's a word enough.


* GLOBAL RECOGNITION.
I have heard of people who are privilege to travel out to other countries without their own excess spending,they got sponsored by friend's, connecting to different people around the world is the best way to expand civilization worldwide,the world is ours,so let stroll around it, extend your boundary of friendship by meeting new people who will impact positively in your and Hive is a good place for that.


Thank you for reading.
Daniel kuye.

content.body:
As 2025 begins, I envisioned building and achieving a goal on hive that reflects my passion and expertise. As a creative individual I plan to produce contents that sparks creativity and intrigued individual when they read, whether it's writing, diy , sharing photography or exploring other forms of digital art. Hive is more than just a blogging platform, it is an interconnected ecosystem of content creator and writers that brings like mind individual and minds together. My vision for hive this year includes becoming knowledgeable about hive core principle and rules such as decentralization, transparency, and user empowerment, community involvement and personal development. ![pexels-bertellifotografia-29509447.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eberechi01/23uR3Et5cPyHT2VGBuuFk538oaHM2zARorh7Qwz5mzs9MjZYEk8hnDggtLWiYbJK8CdeY.jpg) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/close-up-of-2025-planner-with-earphones-and-sticky-notes-29509447/)
As a newcomer to hive I am excited to explore through the amazing content written by users of great minds , although I am just beginning my journey and it's only been a year since I joined hive but I have a vision of how I can grow in hive and how the platform itself can also evolve. Consistency and quality will and always is my guiding principles, as someone who aims to do well in hive I aim to post regularly and engage actively with other users and comment thoughtfully on their post too. Over time, I hope to earn trust and recognition from the various community on hive, which will motivate me to keep improving and contributing meaningfully on hive.
Additionally, I intend to explore ways to use the hive tokens for real world application, such as investing in the hive platform and helping charitable causes or reinvesting in hive based initiative that promote innovative and sustainability. Hive thrives on creativity and my first goal is to establish as a consistent content creator and identity my niche - whether it's blogging, gaming, diy/Art or any other area of interest and focus on producing high quality post. My target per week is two post,each offering valuable insight and entertaining my audience. Overtime I aspire to create or co manage a community that serve as a hub for like minded individual to connect, collaborate and share ideas. By fostering togetherness I aim at strengthen my role within the hive ecosystem. ![goal-2045924_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eberechi01/23tc1Gbz73HBAJVzFscmtyTY5F5fWLZfg3KxBqnL34WHz76YPNxCmkftKGrBohRbDq93V.jpg) [Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/goal-arrive-to-achieve-set-target-2045924/)
In conclusion, planning my hive goals for 2025 will be an exciting and creative journey of self discovery, creativity and person growth. By focusing on content creation, community development and promoting hive, I hope to make an impactful meaning on hive while achieving success. With dedication and consistency, I am positive and confident that this 2025 will be a transformative and enjoyable year for my hive experience. ##
THANK YOU FOR READING THROUGH
